content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task reporting page","i_want":"to sort the tasks in the report by Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority","so_that":"I can see the tasks in the order that matters to me","business_description":"The reporting page lists the user's tasks in a table. The user can choose one of four sort fields (Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority), and the report API applies that sort to the task data.","business_value":"Sorting by date, status or priority lets the user find the most urgent or relevant tasks faster in the report table.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Creation Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Creation Date","then":"The table rows are reordered so that the Creation Date values are in a single consistent order (ascending or descending, as defined by the sort control) and the sort option shown as selected is Creation Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Due Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Due Date","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Due Date field and the sort option shown as selected is Due Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Status values","when":"The user selects the sort option Status","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Status field and the sort option shown as selected is Status"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Priority values","when":"The user selects the sort option Priority","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Priority field and the sort option shown as selected is Priority"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field of creation_date, due_date, status or priority","when":"The request is processed by the backend","then":"The response contains the matching tasks ordered by that field"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field that is not one of creation_date, due_date, status or priority","when":"The request is processed by the backend","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no task data is returned"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state the sort direction (ascending or descending) or whether it can be toggled; this is an open question.","The PRD does not define the order of Status values (Open, In Progress, Completed) or Priority values (Low, Medium, High) when sorting; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state how tasks with equal sort values are ordered; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state whether Due Date is mandatory; tasks without a Due Date may need a defined position in the sort order, which is an open question.","Sorting by a field is applied to the full set of tasks returned by the report, including the effect of filters and search from other stories; the interaction is not specified in this story."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report API accepts a sort field parameter with the values creation_date, due_date, status and priority, and returns tasks in that order.","The report API returns a documented invalid input error for unsupported sort fields.","The Task Reporting page provides a sort control with exactly the four options Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority.","Selecting a sort option reorders the table rows using the backend response, without optimistic reordering.","Open questions on sort direction, Status and Priority order, tie handling and missing Due Date are recorded in the story notes.","Automated tests cover each sort field on the API and on the reporting page."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-api-sort-parameter","title":"[BE] Add sort parameter to the task report endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the task report API so it accepts a sort field (creation_date, due_date, status, priority) and returns the tasks ordered by that field. Reject unsupported sort fields with the standard invalid input error.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint accepts a sort field parameter and returns tasks ordered by it.","Unsupported sort fields return an invalid input error.","Sort is applied to stored Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority values.","Endpoint behaviour is documented, including the sort parameter values."]},{"key_slug":"report-table-sort-control","title":"[FE] Add sort control with four options to the report table","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add a sort control to the Task Reporting page with the options Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority. Selecting an option requests the sorted data from the report API and shows the returned order.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-f214002a"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Sort control lists exactly Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority.","Selecting an option calls the report API with the matching sort field.","Table order updates only after the API responds successfully.","A message is shown if the sorted request fails."]},{"key_slug":"report-sort-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for report task sorting","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests for sorting of report tasks at API and UI level, covering each sort field, invalid sort values and the order of returned rows.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":[],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["API tests cover each valid sort field and an invalid sort field.","UI tests cover selecting each of the four sort options and checking row order.","Test suite runs in the continuous integration pipeline and passes."]}]}
